item.title: Trend & Selection Fameworks
item.description:
The First Job — General Finance Company

It was Gudi Padwa in March 2007. I went for a job interview. The company was called General Finance Company; the owner’s name was Anand. The entire interview was in Hindi. I got selected on the spot and was told to join the next day.

Until then, in every English interview, whenever I wanted to say “yes,” only “ya” came out of my mouth. So, when Anand Sir asked questions in Hindi and I answered in Hindi, every time I had to agree, “ya” slipped out automatically. I laughed inside.
